name: MYRC
oneLiner: MYRC is Blox's ringgit stablecoin backed 1:1 by MYR-denominated reserves at Malaysian financial institutions and gated to verified Malaysian residents.
collateral: Malaysian ringgit cash deposits at undisclosed banks (66.68%) and Halogen Shariah MYR Liquid Fund (33.32%) in the August 2026 reserve examination; bank identities, provider concentration and legal account safeguards remain undisclosed
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint and redemption against Malaysian Ringgit via Malaysian banking rails (FPX). Eligibility requires Malaysian eKYC (MyKad) and a linked Malaysian bank account; mint authority on each chain is restricted to a Blox-controlled key.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: BLOX describes MYRC as a 1:1 Malaysian Ringgit stablecoin minted and redeemed through domestic banking rails and backed by ringgit-denominated reserve assets held at Malaysian financial institutions. The reviewed product, transparency, and whitepaper materials do not identify the current asset classes or institutions and do not support the prior Maybank and UTMB attribution.

latestReport.reviewer: Sol curation pass 2026-10-01 (CurM02USDK); August examination dated 2026-09-29; publication date not separately stated in the report

sources.label: Tommy Ung & Partners PLT MYRC reserve examination (2026-08-31; signed 2026-09-29)

notices.title: Issuer not licensed
notices.message: Blox Blockchain Sdn Bhd does not hold a Bank Negara Malaysia or Securities Commission Malaysia license. SC Malaysia disclaimed jurisdiction in 2022; BNM has not yet established a payment-stablecoin framework as of 2026.

notices.title: Small float, single-jurisdiction
notices.message: MYRC has a small circulating float and its reserve disclosures identify only Malaysian financial institutions, without naming providers or publishing provider concentration.
